notes.title: Update 0.6.72! Build now your own house from parts!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28067786/2b0563341379fd217d1d1df6909a11bf533e9901.jpg
With the latest update you can now build your own houses. There are 6 different elements available (more will follow).

New

Now, it's possible to build your own houses. There are 6 different elements: Foundation, wall, door frame, door, ceiling and stairs.

Changed

The crafting window has been improved and new categories added.
Charcoal Kiln now requires trunks instead of branches.

Modding

Items, structures, and house parts are now defined in the products.lua file.

Hint

You can rotate house parts while placing with [mouse wheel].
You can rotate built house parts with [T].
You can remove house parts by holding down [T].
If you tear down house parts, you will get back 65% of the materials (rounded up).

notes.title: Update 0.6.70! Animal Trap, Earthworms & Rabbits!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28067786/8f1f9dbccfa6d03b6d3418354129ce0c0c28a365.jpg
New

New structure: Animal Trap! You can catch rabbits with this trap.
New animal: Rabbit! You can catch them in traps, but they do not yet exist in the world.
New animal: Earthworm! Under some stones you will find an earthworm.
New item: Fish Bait! Craft it to catch fish.
New item: Rabbit Bait! Craft it to catch rabbits.
New Item: Net! Is made of 3 strings.
New icons for items: Drumstick (raw), Meat Small (roasted), Fish (roasted).
Now there is a second swamp with stinging nettles and frogs.
The swamp now has a sound and a particle effect.
There are now some new tips displayed while playing.

Changed

The grass is smaller now.
The amount of stones has been increased.
To build a fish trap, you need 3 Branches, 3 Twigs and 1 Net.
The fish trap window has been redesigned.
The effectivity of the fish trap is now calculated differently.
Traps now need a specific bait.
The display of tips during the game has been redesigned.

Fixed

The tips during the game are displayed again.
Plants can now be looted again.
If you move an item with the mouse and close the inventory and the inventory is full, the item is no longer destroyed, it's placed on the ground.

Hint

You can find earthworms under rocks. Pick it up with [E]. If you kill them, they will be useless.

notes.title: Update 0.6.68! Land in sight!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28067786/193cd3f9f394ae116f37890f23f2e5ac572e7798.jpg
I am glad that the new island is ready now! It was a lot of work, but it was worth it. The new island is bigger and offers everything: Mountains, valleys, islands, meadows, forests ... Thanks to a new system, the vegetation is much denser and with better performance. The plants are still interactive. The grass is also prettier and denser.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28067786/2c0b821ef4363b5914623e8277de98ebfc31f78f.jpg

When you open the inventory, you will now see a "Support Developer" window and a "Suggest Item Description" button. This is a test I want to do with the community. If you read an item description while playing and you think "I have a better idea", you can send the idea there. Right in the game.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28067786/dce0413587d6200548a2cbab57f8c21eda1f1fe9.jpg

New

A brand new, huge island with high mountains, valleys.
Many new tree species and plant species.
In the sea there are now big seagrass tufts!
New Item: Bone! There is currently no use for this.
New resource: Flint! Find this valuable resource in 3 different locations (all located on stone-ground). Do not forget the pickaxe!
Now you can also make axe, pickaxe and hammer from flint. They are much more durable and effective!
There are now bones and goat skulls that can be found. There are places where wolves are stationary. These are especially good places to find bones, but it is dangerous.
There are now 6 additional graphics settings: Terrain complexity, grass distance, grass density, tree distance, tree complexity and ocean quality.
If you now fall a palm, there is a 25% chance that a coconut will fall down.
You can now drink dirty water (swamp).
New effect: Nausea! You get it by a chance of 50% if you drink dirty water. When sleeping, it disappears by a chance of 80%.
New achievement: "Kill a Bear"!
Axe and pickaxe are now preset in the action bar.
Now you can suggest new item descriptions directly in the game.

Changed

Many objects were enlarged and the number increased.
Log entries are now displayed for 4 seconds instead of just 2 seconds.

Fixed

The craft window now also displays the extensive tooltips.

Hint

Sources spawn only in higher regions. Find one as fast as possible, they are easy to hear (water splashing).
If you find a dead tree trunk, there are usually mushrooms nearby. Remember this place and leave the tree trunk lying.

notes.title: Update 0.6.65! Bears, wolves and bags!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28067786/6cf5a6e2cfc7b43297233782aed412ea3c56cd8f.gif
New update is here! Two new predators wander on the island. Bears and wolves! Bears are very strong, don't fight them! You can always run away, but you have to be quick! Now, you can extend your inventory space with two types of bags! And a lot more improvements!

New

New animal: Wolves! They are now roaming the island! They attack you if you get too close.
New animal: Bears! Now you can find bears! Bears are proud animals, you should treat them with respect. They are not very aggressive and track you a short distance. But if you just throw a small stick at his head, he'll chase you until you're dead.
New item: Palm Leaf Satchel! With this handy bag you can enlarge your inventory by 6 places.
New item: Leather Bag! Extends the inventory even by 12 places!
New item: Leather! You can loot it from dead animals.
Greatly improved console with new commands.
You can now quickly loot items by holding down the [SHIFT] key while clicking.
Totally revised tooltips! You are now displaying a lot of information.

Changed

All camera effects have been updated. The "Motion Blur" effect is now visually much nicer and the "near-death" effect now has more contrast.
The run and sprint speed was reduced very little.
The blood stains on the monitor stop blocking the mouse pointer.
The loot window now has new buttons (Close and tooltip).
Sea turtles are now giving [Big Meat].
Inventory size has been reduced to 12 (can now be expanded with items).

notes.title: Update 0.6.63!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28067786/378336042bc4741c2135100e240c50841c4df300.gif
What!? Another update?

Sure, of course! Now there is an action bar that allows you to quickly use items with the keys [1] - [9] and with the key [0] you get your hands free quickly. It makes playing a lot easier!

But that is not all! The "New" and "Load" buttons have completely disappeared from the main menu. Instead of these, there is only one "Play" button. This brings you to the four save slots, which now show information about the save game and even a screenshot!

New

There is now an action bar with 9 free slots that you can fill with any item.
The loading window has been replaced by a completely new "Play"-window.
Each save slot now displays various information (playing time, day, ...) and a message appears when loading outdated save slots.
A screenshot will now be displayed for each save slot.
There are now four save slots.
The buttons in the menus now have a click sound.

Changed

Log entries are displayed longer.
Durability of tools are displayed larger.
Now get branches from felled conifers.
The aspect ratio of the Moongate video is correct now.

Fixed

Save slot 3 works again.
The settings window works in the main menu again.

Hint

Use the [0] key to quickly clear your hands and remove weapons or tools.
Delete slots on the action bar with the middle mouse button.

notes.title: Update 0.6.6! Snakes, Snails, Poison
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28067786/df963e6d83aefd890026d1829fa92977e584e110.gif
In this update, you are the first time in the sights of enemy animals! The new snakes are snappy and a bite has a 50% chance of triggering poisoning. To create an antidote, you need glands of snails, but they are only in rain on the way...

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28067786/ac353c90b28a044c0c0e633adef6df87b8e59e9c.gif

Info

Due to changes in the settings file, it is resetted at game start.

Added

New animal: Snakes! A bite has a 50% chance of poison!
New animal: Snails! They are only on rainy days.
New effect: Poison XX! This poison is usually not lethal to healthy people.
New item: Antitoxin XX! Cure poison with it.
Now, effects have tooltips.
If the player suffers damage, a matching effect appears.
Motion Blur is added. Can be deactivated in settings.
When the game starts, a nice Moongate video is displayed.
Seagulls are in the main menu and they like to land on the rocks.
We started to create LIN moddable. You can now create your own effects with Lua.

Changed

The damage distance of weapons and tools was little shortened.
Hits of weapons and tools are now little faster.
Shells have a new icon.

Fixed

"Breath" and "Exhaustion" is now translated correctly and improved (no overlapping texts).
Log window is improved.

Hints

Snakes have a 100% chance to spawn a [Meat Small] and a 10% chance to spawn a [Slimy Gland].
You can dodge snake bites, if you are attentively.
If it's raining, snails are on the way. Snails have a 100% chance to spawn [Green Slime] and 50% chance to spawn a [Slimy Gland].
You need 2x [Slimy Gland] and 1x [Ash] to craft an antitoxin.
Poison is stackable to 5! If you are poisoned, you can survive with full health, don't get poison multiple time!

Known Issues

Save slot 3 is not working correct. (fix coming soon)
Settings window can't be opened in main menu. (fix coming soon)


Feel free to give a feedback!

PS: Thank you for completing the survey (available on main screen), it helped a lot!

notes.title: Welcome to update 0.6.5!
notes.notes:
There are some renewals for Lost in Nature!

When you start the game, you can now solve the new extensive survey! The link can be found in the main menu.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/28067786/c140e849cdd96ec79d69cae281009c73fd351f2c.jpg

Patchlog 0.6.5

Added

New structure: Straw Bed!

Build a makeshift bed of twigs and leaves.
During night, you can sleep in it.
During sleep your hunger and thirst increase only half as fast.
During sleep your sanity regenerates.
If hunger or thirst drops to 0 during sleep, you will wake up.

New item: Stinging Nettle! Create strings with it!
New Item: Twigs! Can be found in bushes.
New Item: Leaves! Can be collected from ferns.
New object: Bush! Collect twigs from bushes! They regenerate within 3 days.
New object fern! To collect leaves.
You can use the new SSAA system in the graphics settings. SSAA is very resource intensive!
New Steam achievement: Kill a frog.
A help text will now appear if you try to collect an item and you're not fast enough.
The item "Bark" now has an icon.
Trees are regenerating now and can be searched again after 6 days.


Changed

Sea turtles have less healthpoints.
By day, the sanity regenerates a little less quickly.


Fixed

Various things have been optimized.


Known Issues

With every kill of a frog, the success appears, instead of only the first time.

notes.title: Welcome to update 0.6.43!
notes.notes:
I'm working on a new island since a long time, but today a new update is coming out.

Now you can change the key assignment in the new revised "Settings" window.

Thanks to the community, Russian is now available as a new language.

If you see errors in the game or missing translations, you can apply change requests in the new language manager. Perhaps you have a lot of good ideas for new item descriptions?

Use the new hammer to remove structures.

Due to the changes, the previous settings must be reconfigured.

Moongate Community
Steam Community

Patchlog 0.6.43

Added
- The "Settings" window has been completely revised:
	- A tooltip can now be displayed for each setting.
	- Settings have been spread across multiple tabs.
	- More space and everything is clearer.
- The key assignment can now be customized in the settings.
- New tool "Hammer" can remove structures.
- New language manager to create translations and suggest for changes.
- Thanks to the community, the language "Russian" is now available.

Changed
- Weather system has been optimized.
- Game Over screen has been optimized and can be skipped with [ESC].

Fixed
- "Game Over" button now works correctly.
- "Game Over" button is now translated correctly.

notes.title: Update 0.6.1
notes.notes:
There was some confusion when searching through trees, because it was not clear that you had to grab the items with [E].

If you have problems with performance, disable SSAA! This is extremely resource intensive!

Restart Steam to get the update.

Patch Notes

Added
- "Learning By Doing" is added now. You get helpful hints while you play.
- Trees have now different sizes.

Changed
- The amount of trees is reduced.
- Terrain textures are finer tiled.
- Tooltip improved, if you are searching through objects.
- Durability of tools increased by 200%.
- Chopping and mining is much faster.
- Sanity is regenerating during day andby  good weather.
- Sanity loss decreased in general.
- If you are more than 20% wet, your sanity loss is reduced by 50%.
- You can scroll in settings window much faster and it's no longer elastic.

Fixed
- You can close containers by clicking on [x].
- Loading screen is now localized.
- Game over screen is now localized.
- Mining window is now localized.
- "Wrong Tool" tooltip is now localized.
- Some translation correctures.
- Dead trees have no longer a interaction tooltip.

Known Issues
- FPS calculation is wrong.
